page.notes: Several entries have a decorative initial "C" at the start of the first line ("Cafualis"/"Ca-sualis" read as Casualis, given as printed "Afualis" with the initial C enlarged). Some printed words are doubtful in the scan: "Afualis" is probably "Casualis", "Cæusativa" probably "Causativa". Entries marked with ornaments and small marks have not been transcribed.
